note: PIPE UP starter deck. Every question is written to be answerable equally well anywhere in the world - no holidays, school systems, sports leagues, or region-locked pop culture. Host can shuffle by id and/or filter by category. Always keep a 'type your own' option alongside this.

questions.text: What's the most useless talent you have?

What's a small thing that reliably makes your day better?
Name a sound you love and a sound you can't stand.
If you had to eat one meal for the rest of your life, what is it?
What's the most beautiful place you've ever stood?
What's a smell that instantly takes you somewhere else?
What would the title of your autobiography be?
If this week had a soundtrack, what song is playing right now?
What's something you've completely changed your mind about?
What's the most irrational fear you have?
What's a skill you've pretended to have to get out of (or into) something?
What's the pettiest reason you've ever disliked someone?
What's something everyone seems to love that you secretly don't get?
What's the worst advice you ever actually followed?
What's a tiny lie you tell all the time?
What's the most embarrassing thing you've done to avoid talking to someone?
What habit do you have now that would horrify your younger self?
What's something you're weirdly, surprisingly bad at?
What's the longest you've kept defending something you knew was a bad idea?
